statement.text:
Let $M$ be a closed hyperbolic 3-manifold with positive first Betti number.

(a) Which elements of $H^{2}(M;\mathbb{R})$ are realized as the Euler classes of taut foliations?

(b) Which elements of $H^{2}(M;\mathbb{R})$ are realized as the Euler classes of tight contact structures?

(c) How about universally tight contact structures?

(d) The question can also be asked for pseudo-Anosov flows...

(e)... and for quasi-geodesic flows. (f ) How about Euler classes of representations into $\operatorname{Homeo}^{+}(S^1)$?
